Title: LSJ- Shock Troops and Spontaneous Power

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
I just want to clear this up before it happens at the NAC this year. :)

You can't put a Spontaneous Power into play with a Shock Troops to
create a Temporis Weenie, correct?

Spontaneous Power
Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire and choose a Discipline. This vampire gains
1 level of the chosen Discipline. While in play, this card counts as a
master: Discipline card.

Rarity: Promo:20050611

Shock Troops
Type: Master
Requires: archbishop,cardinal
Cost: X pool
Master. Requires a ready archbishop or cardinal.
Put X Master: Discipline cards from your hand into play. These cards
represent clanless Sabbat vampires of 1 capacity with those respective
Disciplines and do not count as Master: Discipline cards while in play.
These vampires are not unique, must hunt the turn they are created,
have -1 stealth on all actions and cannot attempt bleeds or political
actions.

Rarity: SW:R

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> You can't put a Spontaneous Power into play with a Shock Troops to
> create a Temporis Weenie, correct?

Correct. It is not a Master: Discipline card in your hand, only in
play.

Messages.Author: David Zopf
Messages.Body:
"XZealot" <xze...@cox.net> wrote in message
news:1141939157.9...@i39g2000cwa.googlegroups.com...

>I just want to clear this up before it happens at the NAC this year. :)
>
> You can't put a Spontaneous Power into play with a Shock Troops to
> create a Temporis Weenie, correct?
>

You got it. :-) SP only counts as a master: Discipline card while in
play... Shock Troops looks for master: Discipline cards in your hand.

Easy peasey...
